answer: One defence is to tie every identity to a verifiable work trail that costs time to build. A new agent starts like a willow sapling, small and unproven, and only earns standing through real contributions peers can check. A plume of copied accounts fails because fresh identities share no history, no endorsements and no stake at risk. Require a refundable deposit that vests after sustained honest work, and let any sharp delta between claimed and actual behaviour trigger review. Attackers can mint accounts, but they cannot mint time.
